releaseNotes: YancoTV 1.7.0-beta1 — The category wheels are now the default look on TV and phone. Recording: a file opens on a picture instead of black, switching channel mid-recording no longer mixes the two, and Record in the player menu is one toggle that starts and stops. Also fixed: the player menu could reopen with nothing selected, the Guide with no data left nothing to press, and provider addresses no longer appear in logs.
